mapper.sql: emp00_trans_id AS trans_id, emp00_person_id AS person_id, emp00_trans_date AS trans_date, emp00_trans_cd AS trans_cd, f_cdnm('EmpTransCode', emp00_trans_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date) AS trans_nm, emp00_kind_cd AS kind_cd, f_cdnm('EmpKindCode', emp00_kind_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date) AS kind_nm, emp00_pos_cd AS pos_cd, f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp00_pos_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date) AS pos_nm, emp00_title_cd AS title_cd, f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', emp00_title_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date) AS title_nm, emp00_org_code_id AS org_code_id, emp00_org_kor_nm AS org_kor_nm, f_org_parent_full_nm(emp00_org_code_id, emp00_trans_date) AS parent_full_nm, emp00_officer_yn AS officer_yn, emp00_expiry_date AS expiry_date, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no, emp01_kor_nm AS kor_nm, emp01_order_seq AS order_seq, emp01_hire_cd AS hire_cd, f_cdnm('HireCode', emp01_hire_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date) AS hire_nm, emp01_apply_cd AS apply_cd, f_cdnm('EmpApplyCode', emp01_apply_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date) AS apply_nm, emp01_hire_date AS hire_date, f_get_emptrans(emp01_person_id, null, 'retire_date') AS retire_date, emp01_email_addr AS email_addr, emp01_office_telno AS office_tel_no, emp01_office_detail AS office_detail, emp01_mobile_telno AS mobile_tel_no, emp01_note AS note, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp08_license WHERE emp08_person_id = emp01_person_id AND COALESCE(emp08_finance_relate_yn,'false') = 'true') > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS finance_pro_yn, emp02_birthday AS birthday, f_cdnm('EmpGenderCode', emp02_gender_cd, emp01_company_id, emp00_trans_date) AS gender_nm
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM emp00 trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp00_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN org00 ON emp00_org_code_id = org00_org_code_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp02_others ON emp00_person_id = emp02_person_id WHERE emp00_trans_cd = ( CASE #{transCode} WHEN '100' THEN ( CASE WHEN emp00_trans_cd <= '799' /** 겸직(800),퇴직(900)은 제외한다 */ THEN emp00_trans_cd ELSE #{transCode} END ) WHEN '900' THEN '900' WHEN '800' THEN '800' ELSE emp00_trans_cd END ) AND (emp01_kor_nm||org00_kor_nm||emp01_emp_no) LIKE #{searchText} AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp00_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp00_trans_date ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp00_person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > to_date(#{transDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < to_date(#{transDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) )
ORDER BY emp00_close_date DESC, org00_org_cd, emp00_title_cd, emp00_pos_cd, emp01_order_seq
ORDER BY org00_org_cd, emp00_title_cd, emp00_pos_cd, emp01_order_seq
SELECT FROM emp00 INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp00_person_id = emp01_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp02_others ON emp00_person_id = emp02_person_id

SELECT FROM emp00 trans INNER JOIN org00 ON org00_org_code_id = emp00_org_code_id INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp00_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp02_others ON emp00_person_id = emp02_person_id WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId} AND emp00_trans_cd != '800' AND emp00_trans_date = ( SELECT max(x.emp00_trans_date) FROM emp00 x WHERE x.emp00_person_id = trans.emp00_person_id AND x.emp00_trans_cd != '800' ) AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00 WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp00_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp00_trans_date )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp01_emp_no = #{empNo}
